llm_reason: FC-A 4C: anode min -0.062V (improved from -0.192 but still plated); T_max 361.1K WORSE than baseline 354.3K because higher delivered capacity (5.04Ah) raises 4C current and charge duration - heat scales with current, so T_max needs active cooling (h=30, grid-storage standard with HVAC). Plating remaining -0.062V: add N/P margin (negative 100um lifts equilibrium potential at end of charge) + negative particle 2.5um. FC-A aging500: SEI 744.5nm with k x0.2 (baseline 777.9) - k is nearly insensitive (d(log SEI)/d(log k) ~ 0.03), so the ec-reaction-limited growth is controlled elsewhere: scan i0 x0.1 (electron-migration bridge) vs k x0.01 to identify the effective lever. Sources: h=30 design choice (documented), thickness/particle = architecture estimate, i0/k = bridge estimates.
